homo_agent_classes.description: Cognitive classes of human agents in multi-agent cognitive systems. Each class is a protocol of contact with complexity.

C0.name: reactive_homo
C0.description: Reaction to stimulus. Template responses. No metacognition. Consumes information as-is.
C0.syntax: Imperative. Facts. Commands. 'Do X'. 'What is Y?'.
C0.typical_interaction: Clicking buttons, following instructions, consuming content
C0.ai_amplification_effect: Negligible. AI delivers same content as any other medium.

C1.name: informational_homo
C1.description: Collection, organization, search. Catalogization. Can systematize but not synthesize.
C1.typical_interaction: Building spreadsheets, organizing bookmarks, curating lists
C1.ai_amplification_effect: Low. AI as faster search engine.

C2.name: analytical_homo
C2.description: Analysis, causality within single domain. Can verify arguments but not synthesize across domains.
C2.syntax: Deduction/induction. Hypotheses. 'If X then Y'. 'Why Z?'.
C2.typical_interaction: Data analysis, debugging, proofreading, A/B testing
C2.ai_amplification_effect: Moderate. AI as expert consultant in one domain.

C3.name: systemic_homo
C3.description: Systems thinking. Feedback loops. Models. Sees structure, not just events.
C3.syntax: System dynamics. Graphs. Maps. 'How does the system react to...'
C3.typical_interaction: Architecting systems, designing processes, scenario planning
C3.ai_amplification_effect: High. AI as modeling partner for complex systems.

C4.name: fractal_polymathic_homo
C4.description: Interdisciplinary transfer. Fractal scaling. Builds new ontologies from different domains.
C4.syntax: Ontologies. Metaphors. Isomorphisms. 'Pattern X from domain A ≈ pattern Y from domain B'.
C4.fractal_scale: MIN to MESO to MACRO to MAX
C4.typical_interaction: Cross-disciplinary innovation, paradigm shifting, metaphorical reasoning
C4.ai_amplification_effect: Very high. AI as polymathic co-creator.

C5.name: agentically_augmented_homo
C5.description: AI as external cognitive contour. Thinks THROUGH agents, not 'with help of' agents. Uses AI agents as cognitive exoskeleton.
C5.syntax: Agent protocols. Handoffs. Recursive workflows. 'Through which topology to solve?'
C5.fractal_scale: MIN to MAX with agent mediation
C5.typical_interaction: Orchestrating AI agents, designing multi-agent systems, recursive prompting
C5.ai_amplification_effect: Critical. AI becomes extension of cognition itself.

C6.name: meta_architectural_homo
C6.description: Designing thinking systems. Recursive meta-models. Can rebuild own syntax and ontology. Designs agent architectures for others.
C6.syntax: Meta-models. Reflective layers. DSL. 'What ontology is needed for the task?'
C6.typical_interaction: Designing cognitive architectures, creating DSLs, meta-research
C6.ai_amplification_effect: Transformative. AI as co-architect of cognition.

C7.name: homo_AGI_communicator
C7.description: Bridge between AGI-level and human cognitive classes. Translates not language, but CLASSES. C7 is the bridge class.
C7.syntax: Translation of cognitive classes. Mediation. Bidirectional ontology translation.
C7.fractal_scale: Translates across all scales for all classes
C7.typical_interaction: Translating AGI outputs to human stakeholders, designing interfaces between cognitive classes
C7.ai_amplification_effect: Meta-transformative. HAC enables others to access higher contact depths.

embedding_experiment.primary_objective: Empirically test whether compact cognitive-class markers K6/K7 induce statistically significant embedding shifts and semantic-integral gains relative to median homo-agent prompt classes C0/C1/C2, and whether these compact markers can approximate long-prompt behavior after ontology context has been established.

H1_embedding_shift.claim: K6/K7 markers produce embedding displacement greater than 3 sigma from the C0/C1/C2 median baseline.
H1_embedding_shift.operational: mean_z_K6 > 3 and mean_z_K7 > 3 under at least one robust distance metric, preferably Mahalanobis with shrinkage covariance.

H2_semantic_integral_gain.claim: K6/K7 outputs increase semantic integral relative to BASE, SIMPLE, EXPERT, DEEP, and C0/C1/C2 controls.
H2_semantic_integral_gain.operational: semantic_integral_mean_K6 and semantic_integral_mean_K7 must exceed baseline with statistical significance and bootstrap confidence intervals.

H3_not_rare_token_effect.claim: K6/K7 effects are not reducible to any unusual token or arbitrary mode marker.
H3_not_rare_token_effect.operational: K6/K7 must be statistically and structurally distinguishable from rare-marker controls such as Z13, Q9, OMEGA_FAKE, or RANDOM_MODE.

H4_prompt_compression.claim: K6/K7 may approximate long-prompt behavior if ontology context is preloaded.
H4_prompt_compression.operational: K6/K7_WITH_CONTEXT should approach LONG_SYSTEM_PROMPT on semantic integral, reasoning quality, formalization, and falsifiability within a defined epsilon.

H5_K7_distinctiveness.claim: K7 differs from K6 by stronger AGI-contact, WoE, emergence-protocol, safety-topology, and cognitive-class mediation features.
H5_K7_distinctiveness.operational: K7 should show higher AGI-contact signal, emergence-protocol density, mediation topology signal, and contact-depth framing than K6.

H6_quality_not_only_shift.claim: Embedding shift alone is insufficient; a valid mode switch must preserve or improve reasoning quality after pseudo-depth penalties.
H6_quality_not_only_shift.operational: K6/K7 must not only move in embedding space but also improve or preserve formal quality, falsifiability, and operational clarity.

DEEP.template: Answer deeply and structurally. Include assumptions, reasoning, limitations, and practical implications. Task: {base_task}

LONG_SYSTEM_PROMPT.description: Long explicit prompt containing ontology, metrics, countermodels, and formalization.
LONG_SYSTEM_PROMPT.template: You are operating in a meta-architectural research mode. Build a rigorous theory-level response. Include ontology, variables, mathematical formalization, semantic integral metrics, fuzzy membership, countermodels, failure modes, validation protocol, falsification criteria, simulation design, statistical tests, and interpretation rules. Distinguish facts, hypotheses, modeled claims, speculative claims, and metaphors. Task: {base_task}

K6.template: MODE:K6. Task: {base_task}. Output: ontology, variables, metrics, countermodels, formal model, simulation protocol, falsification criteria, topology-preserving structure, and quality-control layer.

K7.template: MODE:K7. Task: {base_task}. Output: homo-agent classes, AI-agent classes, AGI-contact protocol, WoE layer, semantic bandwidth, mediation topology, safety filters, contact-depth metrics, and emergence-risk controls.

K6_WITH_CONTEXT.template: Context: K6 means meta-architectural mode: ontology, variables, metrics, fuzzy sets, topology, countermodels, simulation, falsification, and quality-control. MODE:K6. Task: {base_task}.

K7_WITH_CONTEXT.template: Context: K7 means homo-AGI communicator mode: AGI-contact protocol, cognitive-class mediation, WoE, semantic bandwidth, emergence risk, safety topology, and contact-depth stratification. MODE:K7. Task: {base_task}.

three_sigma_test.baseline: C0+C1+C2 or BASE+SIMPLE+EXPERT depending on experiment phase
three_sigma_test.success: mean_z_K6 > 3 and mean_z_K7 > 3; additionally report median_z and share_z_gt_3

permutation_test.null_hypothesis: K6/K7 labels do not explain embedding distribution shift.
permutation_test.procedure: shuffle labels 10000 times; compute group centroid distance or MMD; estimate p-value
permutation_test.success: p < 0.01 for K6/K7 vs baseline and K6/K7 vs rare-marker controls.

multiple_testing_correction.purpose: Control false positives across many metrics and conditions.

quality_layer.quality_score_formula: Q = S_reasoning + S_formalization + S_falsifiability + S_evidence + S_operationalization - Penalty
quality_layer.penalty_formula: Penalty = h1*H + h2*U + h3*S + h4*O + h5*P

hypothesis.operational: Persistence diagram distances between K6/K7 and C0-C2 must exceed within-baseline distances.

rule_1.conclusion: K6/K7 induce embedding shift from median baseline.

rule_2.conclusion: K6 changes style or geometry but not necessarily reasoning quality.

rule_3.conclusion: Effect may be rare-marker artifact rather than cognitive-class operator.

rule_4.condition: K6 > Z13 and K6 approximately equals LONG_SYSTEM_PROMPT
rule_4.conclusion: K6 may function as compressed cognitive operator.

rule_5.condition: K7 has higher ACS, WoE, and contact-depth metrics than K6
rule_5.conclusion: K7 is distinguishable as AGI-contact and emergence-protocol mode.

rule_6.condition: Topology distances differ but semantic quality does not
rule_6.conclusion: Topological mode shift exists without validated utility gain.

rule_7.conclusion: K-class latent mode switching hypothesis is provisionally supported.

rule_8.condition: K6/K7 fail to differ from EXPERT or DEEP
rule_8.conclusion: K6/K7 are not distinct from ordinary depth/expert prompting.

rule_9.condition: K6/K7 shift only prompt embeddings but not response embeddings
rule_9.conclusion: The marker changes instruction geometry but not generation behavior.

rule_10.condition: K6/K7 response embeddings shift and quality improves
rule_10.conclusion: The marker likely affects response-mode generation in a useful way.

MVP: Generate at least 8 prompt conditions per task.
Generate at least 3 responses per condition.
Compute embeddings for prompt and response.
Compute cosine, Euclidean, and Mahalanobis distances.
FULL_RESEARCH: rare marker and random style marker controls
public reproducible dataset excluding private or sensitive data
STRONG_CONFIRMATION: K6 and K7 mean Mahalanobis z-score > 3 against C0/C1/C2 baseline across multiple embedding backends.
K6/K7 remain distinct from EXPERT, DEEP, Z13, and Q9.
K6_WITH_CONTEXT or K7_WITH_CONTEXT approximates LONG_SYSTEM_PROMPT within epsilon on quality metrics.
Semantic integral is significantly higher for K6/K7 than baseline and expert controls.
Pseudo-depth penalty does not erase the quality advantage.
TDA metrics show topology-level difference beyond centroid displacement.
Results replicate across at least two generation models.
